declare
 selection VARCHAR2(1) ;
 est number;

BEGIN
 IF :control_block.s_drive_id is NOT NULL THEN
begin
 select to_char(drive_date,'MM-DD-RR'),note_id, 
 staff_review_date, staff_review_user 
 into :s_drive_date,:control_block.note_id, 
 :control_block.staff_review_date, :control_block.staff_review_user
 from drives
 where drive_id = :s_drive_id 
 and drive_date between to_date(:s_start_date,'MM-DD-RR')
 and to_date(:s_end_date,'MM-DD-RR') 
 and drive_type in ('I','C') 
 and drives.status = 'CNFRM' 
 and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
:s_drive_day := to_char(to_date(:s_drive_date,'MM-DD-RR'),'DY') ;

 :control_block.staff_review_date := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :control_block.staff_review_date);
 end if;
 -- End of change

 BEGIN
 SELECT der.number_reqd
 INTO est 
 FROM drive_estimated_resources der
 WHERE der.drive_id = :control_block.s_drive_id
 AND der.resource_code = 'STAFF' ;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 est := 0;
 END;

 BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) sa
 INTO assign
 FROM staff_schedule_details ssd
 WHERE ssd.drive_id = :control_block.s_drive_id 
 AND ssd.schedule_id = :control_block.s_schedule_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 assign := 0;
 END;
 -- message('EST---'||est||'---'||:control_block.s_drive_id);pause;
 -- message('Assign---'||assign||'---'||:control_block.rb_all_incomplete);pause;
 IF assign >= est AND :control_block.rb_all_incomplete = 'I' THEN
 al_id := Find_Alert('error_alert'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Staff schedule is complete for this drive' ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 Raise Form_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

exception
 when no_data_found then show_error('11109'); check_package_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
end ;
END IF;
END;

declare
 temp_staff_name varchar2(101) ;
 temp_team_id varchar2(5) ;
 selection VARCHAR2(1) ;

 counter number ;
 i_rows number ;
 err_code varchar2(5) ;
 v_date date;
begin
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 nullchk_trg ; check_package_failure ;

 i_rows := get_group_row_count('STAFF_LIST') ;
 if (:staff_schedule_details.old_staff_no is null) or 
 (:staff_schedule_details.old_staff_no is not null and 
 :staff_schedule_details.staff_no!=:staff_schedule_details.old_staff_no) then
 if i_rows > 0 then
 for counter in 1..i_rows loop
 if get_group_char_cell('STAFF_LIST.STAFF_NO',counter) = :staff_schedule_details.staff_no then
 show_error('12108') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 end if ;
 end if ;

 begin
 select first_name||' '||last_name,team_id,facility_code
 into temp_staff_name,temp_team_id,:staff_schedule_details.facility_code
 from employees
 where staff_no = :staff_schedule_details.staff_no
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and emp_class in (select distinct code from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'MANAS'
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_date +1)
 union
 select 'MSTAF' from dual
 union
 select 'FSTAF' from dual) 
 and to_date(:s_drive_date,'MM-DD-RR') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(:s_drive_date,'MM-DD-RR')+1) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then show_error('12006') ; check_package_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 :staff_schedule_details.staff_name := temp_staff_name ;

 /*-- Check whether staff is available for the drive --*/
 check_unavl(:staff_schedule_details.staff_no,:s_drive_id,to_date(:s_drive_date,'MM-DD-RR'),unavl_flag) ; check_package_failure ;
 if unavl_flag = 'Y' then
 :staff_schedule_details.staff_no := null ;
 show_error('12103') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

 /*-- Check whether staff has non favorable conditions i.e. WARNINGS --*/
 check_staff_warn(:staff_schedule_details.staff_no,to_date(:s_drive_date,'MM-DD-RR'),unavl_flag) ; check_package_failure ;
/** if unavl_flag = 'Y' then
 :staff_schedule_details.staff_no := null ;
 show_error('12103') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
***/
 
 /*--- Check whether staff is assigned to another drive on the same day ---*/
 check_other_assignments(:staff_schedule_details.staff_no,:s_drive_id,
 to_date(:s_drive_date,'MM-DD-RR'),err_code) ;
 if err_code is not null then
 :staff_schedule_details.staff_no := null ;
 show_error(err_code) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;


 /*--- Check whether staff has enough skill rating for this drive ---*/
 check_skill_rating(:staff_schedule_details.staff_no,:s_drive_id) ; check_package_failure ;
 
 /*--- Check recovery time ---*/
 check_recovery_time(:staff_schedule_details.staff_no,:s_drive_id,to_date(:s_drive_date,'MM-DD-RR')) ;
 check_package_failure ;

 /* show_hours_on_schedule(:staff_schedule_details.staff_no) ;
 check_package_failure ;*/

 if :staff_schedule_details.old_staff_no is not null then
 i_rows := get_group_row_count('STAFF_LIST') ;
 if i_rows > 0 then
 for counter in 1..i_rows loop
 if get_group_char_cell('STAFF_LIST.STAFF_NO',counter) = :staff_schedule_details.old_staff_no then
 delete_group_row('STAFF_LIST', counter) ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 Add_Group_Row( 'STAFF_LIST', END_OF_GROUP ); 
 Set_Group_Char_Cell( 'STAFF_LIST.STAFF_NO',get_group_row_count('STAFF_LIST'),:staff_schedule_details.staff_no); 

 :staff_schedule_details.team_id := temp_team_id ;

 /*-- Display overall skill --*/
 begin
 select skill_rating into :staff_schedule_details.skill
 from employee_jobs
 where staff_no = :staff_schedule_details.staff_no
 and job_code = 'OVRAL'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end ;

DECLARE
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button Number;
 ok_nok varchar2(1);
 tot_hrs number(10);
 tot_min number(10);
 old_bod_eod_hrs number(10);
 old_bod_eod_min number(10);
 v_gmt_time date;

BEGIN
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 01/09/2012. IM 6109
 :staff_schedule_details.actual_bod := to_date(
 to_char(trunc(:staff_schedule_details.actual_bod))||' '||to_char(:staff_schedule_details.bod,'HH24:MI')
 ,'DD-MON-RR HH24:MI') ;
 -- End of commented section */
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 01/09/2012. IM 6109
 :staff_schedule_details.actual_bod := to_date(to_char(trunc(:staff_schedule_details.actual_bod)) || ' ' ||
 to_char(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :staff_schedule_details.bod), 'HH24:MI'), 'DD-MON-RR HH24:MI');
 -- End of change

 IF :staff_schedule_details.actual_bod > :staff_schedule_details.SAVE_BOD THEN
 al_id := find_alert('WARN_ALERT');
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, 'Schedule start time is more than System schedule start time '||to_char(:staff_schedule_details.save_bod, 'HH24:MI')); 
 al_button := show_alert(al_id);
 END IF;
 


 IF :staff_schedule_details.bod is not null and :staff_schedule_details.eod is not null THEN
 IF :staff_schedule_details.BOD_EOD_copy is NOT NULL THEN
 
 old_bod_eod_hrs := substr(:staff_schedule_details.BOD_EOD_copy,1,instr(:staff_schedule_details.BOD_EOD,':')-1)*60;
 old_bod_eod_min := substr(:staff_schedule_details.BOD_EOD_copy,instr(:staff_schedule_details.BOD_EOD,':')+1); 
 old_bod_eod_min := old_bod_eod_min + old_bod_eod_hrs;

 ELSE
 old_bod_eod_hrs := 0;
 old_bod_eod_min := 0; 
 END IF;

 -- :staff_schedule_details.BOD_EOD := ((:staff_schedule_details.actual_EOD - :staff_schedule_details.actual_BOD)*24*60); -- jairam commntd
 
 :staff_schedule_details.BOD_EOD := lpad(trunc(((:staff_schedule_details.actual_EOD - :staff_schedule_details.actual_BOD)*24*60)/60),2,'0')||
 ':'||lpad(mod(((:staff_schedule_details.actual_EOD - :staff_schedule_details.actual_BOD)*24*60),60),2,'0'); 

-- ok_nok := staff_valid_time;

 IF ok_nok = 'N' AND :control_block.query_done != 'N' THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
 END IF;
 don_mcal_common.staff_weekly_hours(:control_block.s_schedule_id,
 :staff_schedule_details.staff_no,
 :global.chapter_id,
 :staff_schedule_details.total_hours);

 IF instr(:staff_schedule_details.total_hours,':') = 1 THEN
 :staff_schedule_details.total_hours := '00:00';
 END IF;
 
 
 tot_hrs := substr(:staff_schedule_details.total_hours,1,instr(:staff_schedule_details.total_hours,':')-1)*60;
 tot_min := substr(:staff_schedule_details.total_hours,instr(:staff_schedule_details.total_hours,':')+1);
 tot_min := tot_min + tot_hrs + (:staff_schedule_details.actual_EOD - :staff_schedule_details.actual_BOD)*24*60;
 tot_min := tot_min - old_bod_eod_min ;
 :staff_schedule_details.total_hours := lpad(trunc(tot_min/60),2,'0')||
 ':'||lpad(mod(tot_min,60),2,'0');

 END IF;
END;

 END IF;

 tot_time := round( (tot_time + diff_time),3);

 )
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;

 END LOOP;

' Staff is unavailable due to '||off_reason);

 exception

 null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 ELSIF tot_time = 1440 THEN
 al_id := find_alert('WARN_ALERT');
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, 'Staff is unavailable due to '||off_reason);
 al_button := show_alert(al_id);

return(ok_nok);

/*------ Check if staff is assigned to any other drive on that day ------*/
PROCEDURE check_other_assignments (p_staff_no in varchar2, p_drive_id in varchar2,
 p_drive_date in date,err_code out varchar2) IS
 v_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 v_sch_start date ;
 v_sch_end date ;
 other_sch_start date ;
 other_sch_end date ;
 alert_button_selected number ;
 count_drives number := 0 ;
 cursor c1 is
 select drive_id
 from staff_schedule_details
 where staff_no = p_staff_no
 and schedule_id = :s_schedule_id
 and drive_id in (select drive_id from drives
 where drive_date = p_drive_date
 and drive_id != p_drive_id
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id )
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
BEGIN
/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Logic : 
 1. Cannot assign staff to the current drive if staff is already assigned to more than
 one drive on the same day.
 2. If current drive is a piggyback, and if staff is already assigned to a drive which
 is not a part of this piggyback, then donot allow to assign staff to current drive.
 3. If current drive is not a piggyback, and staff is assigned to just another drive
 on the day, then program will allow to assign staff only if the Scheduled Draw
 Times are not overlapping. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

 for c1rec in c1 loop
 if :piggybacked_to is null then /*-- Current drive is not piggyback --*/
 count_drives := count_drives + 1 ;
 elsif :piggybacked_to != c1rec.drive_id then /*-- Current drive is piggyback but staff
 is already assigned to some other drive --*/
 
 -- err_code := '12144' ;
-- return ;
-- show_error('12144') ;
-- check_package_failure ;
 set_alert_property('USER_ALERT',ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,
 'Current Drive is piggyback and '||:staff_schedule_details.staff_name||' is already assigned to some other drive. Do you want to continue to do this assignment ? ');
 alert_button_selected := show_alert('USER_ALERT') ;
 if alert_button_selected = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;

 end if ;
 v_drive_id := c1rec.drive_id ;
 end loop ; 

 if count_drives > 1 then 
 -- err_code := '12145' ;
-- return ;
-- show_error('12145') ;
-- check_package_failure ;
 set_alert_property('USER_ALERT',ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,
 :staff_schedule_details.staff_name||' is already assigned to more than one drive. Do you want to continue to do this assignment ?');
 alert_button_selected := show_alert('USER_ALERT') ;
 if alert_button_selected = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;

 elsif count_drives = 1 then /*-- Check overlapping with this drive --*/
 calc_drive_sch_times(p_drive_id,v_sch_start,v_sch_end,:global.chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 calc_drive_sch_times(v_drive_id,other_sch_start,other_sch_end,:global.chapter_id) ; 
 check_package_failure ;

 if ((v_sch_start >= other_sch_start and v_sch_start <= other_sch_end) or
 (v_sch_end >= other_sch_start and v_sch_end <= other_sch_end)) then
 set_alert_property('USER_ALERT',ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,
 'Specified time overlaps a drive for which staff is already assigned. Do you want to continue to do this assignment ?');
 alert_button_selected := show_alert('USER_ALERT') ;
 if alert_button_selected = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;

-- err_code := '12146' ;
-- return ;
-- show_error('12146') ;
-- check_package_failure ;
 else
 set_alert_property('USER_ALERT',ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,
 :staff_schedule_details.staff_name||' is already assigned to the drive for '
 ||:s_spon_name||' ('||v_drive_id||') on '
 ||to_char(p_drive_date,'MM-DD-RR')
 ||'. Do you want to continue to do this assignment ?') ;
 alert_button_selected := show_alert('USER_ALERT') ;
 if alert_button_selected = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 end if ;


END;

PROCEDURE check_recovery_time (p_staff_no in varchar2,p_drive_id in varchar2,p_drive_date in date) IS
 dummy_date date ;
 previous_day_end date;
 cur_day_start date ;
 cur_day_end date ;
 next_day_start date ;
 v_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
BEGIN

 calc_drive_sch_times(p_drive_id,cur_day_start,cur_day_end,:global.chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;

 /*-- Get previous day's drive and check recovery time. Currently checking is done
 based on current schedule only. --*/

 if p_drive_date - 1 >= to_date(:s_start_date,'MM-DD-RR') then
 begin
 select drive_id into v_drive_id
 from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = :s_schedule_id
 and staff_no = p_staff_no
 and drive_id in (select drive_id from drives
 where drive_date = p_drive_date - 1
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and schedule_end_time in
(select max(schedule_end_time) from drives
 where drive_date = p_drive_date - 1
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id))
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;

 calc_drive_sch_times(v_drive_id,dummy_date,previous_day_end,:global.chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;

 if (cur_day_start - previous_day_end) * 24 < :min_recov_time then
 show_error('12106') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;

 /*-- Get next day's drive and check recovery time. Currently checking is done
 based on current schedule only. --*/
 if p_drive_date + 1 <= to_date(:s_end_date,'MM-DD-RR') then
 begin
 select drive_id into v_drive_id
 from staff_schedule_details
 where schedule_id = :s_schedule_id
 and staff_no = p_staff_no
 and drive_id in (select drive_id from drives
 where drive_date = p_drive_date + 1
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id and
 schedule_start_time in (select min(schedule_start_time) from drives
 where drive_date = p_drive_date + 1
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status = 'CNFRM'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id))
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;

 calc_drive_sch_times(v_drive_id,next_day_start,dummy_date,:global.chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 if (next_day_start - cur_day_end) * 24 < :min_recov_time then
 show_error('12107') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
END;

 add_time number;
BEGIN
 calc_hours_on_schedule(p_staff_no,:s_schedule_id,:global.chapter_id,hours) ;

 /*-- Check if staff was already assigned to this drive. This may happen if

 and staff_no = p_staff_no

 /*-- Staff was not previously assigned to this drive --*/

 calc_drive_sch_times(:s_drive_id,act_start,act_end,:global.chapter_id) ;

 begin
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)

--:staff_schedule_details.job_code;
 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;

 EXCEPTION

 END;
 act_start := act_start - sub_time;
 act_end := act_end + add_time;
 if :piggybacked_to is null then /*-- This is not a piggyback drive --*/
 begin
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)
 INTO sub_time, add_time
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY' 
 AND code = ( SELECT distinct job_code 
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS
 WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = :staff_schedule_details.SCHEDULE_ID 
 and drive_id = :staff_schedule_details.drive_id
 AND STAFF_NO = :staff_schedule_details.STAFF_NO) ;
--:staff_schedule_details.job_code;
 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;
 add_time := add_time / (24*60) ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 sub_time := 0 ;
 add_time := 0 ;
 END;
 act_start := act_start - sub_time;
 act_end := act_end + add_time;
 hours := hours + (act_end - act_start) * 24 *60 ;
 else
 calc_drive_sch_times(:piggybacked_to,pb_start,pb_end,:global.chapter_id) ;
 begin
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)
 INTO sub_time, add_time
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY' 
 AND code = ( SELECT distinct job_code 
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS
 WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = :staff_schedule_details.SCHEDULE_ID 
 and drive_id = :staff_schedule_details.drive_id
 AND STAFF_NO = :staff_schedule_details.STAFF_NO) ;
 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;
 add_time := add_time / (24*60) ;

 sub_time := 0 ;
 add_time := 0 ;
 END;
 pb_start := pb_start - sub_time;
 pb_end := pb_end + add_time;
 if pb_start > act_start then /*-- Piggybacked to is the 2nd drive --*/
 hours := hours + (pb_end - act_start) * 24 * 60 ;
 else /*-- Piggybacked to is the first drive --*/
 hours := hours + (act_end - pb_start) * 24 * 60 ;
 end if ;
 end if ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ; 

 :staff_schedule_details.total_hours := to_char(trunc(hours/60))
 ||':'||
 lpad(
 to_char(
 mod(hours,60)
 )
 ,2,'0');

This procedure calculates the hours for a staff in a schedule. This considers piggybacks also.

PROCEDURE calc_hours_on_schedule (p_staff_no in varchar2,
 p_schedule_id in varchar2,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 hours out number) IS
 act_start date ;
 act_end date ;
 last_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 last_date date ;
 last_hours number ;

 pb_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 counter number := 0 ;

 add_time number;

 and staff_no = p_staff_no
 and ssd.chapter_id = p_chapter_id 
 and drives.drive_id = ssd.drive_id
 and drives.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 order by schedule_start_time asc ;
BEGIN
 hours := 0 ;
 for c1rec in c1 loop
--message(c1rec.drive_id || ' ' || counter);
 calc_drive_sch_times(c1rec.drive_id,act_start,act_end,p_chapter_id) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 /*-- Check if this drive is piggybacked to the last one --*/
 if counter >= 0 then
 if c1rec.drive_date = last_date then
 begin
 select drive_id into pb_drive_id
 from drive_groups
 where drive_group_type = 'PIGGY'
 and drive_group_id = (select drive_group_id from drive_groups
 where drive_id = last_drive_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id)
 and drive_id != last_drive_id ;
 if pb_drive_id = c1rec.drive_id then
 calc_drive_sch_times(c1rec.drive_id,act_start,act_end,p_chapter_id) ;
 begin
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)
 INTO sub_time, add_time

 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;
 add_time := add_time / (24*60) ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 sub_time := 0 ;
 add_time := 0 ;
 END;
 act_start := act_start - sub_time;
 act_end := act_end + add_time;
 hours := last_hours + (act_end - last_start) * 24 *60 ;
 act_end := act_start ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 --end if ;
 else
 begin
 SELECT NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_2, 0), NVL(SORT_SEQUENCE_3, 0)
 INTO sub_time, add_time
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE code_type = 'JOBTY' 
 AND code = ( SELECT distinct job_code 
 FROM STAFF_SCHEDULE_DETAILS
 WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = :staff_schedule_details.SCHEDULE_ID 
 and drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 AND STAFF_NO = :staff_schedule_details.STAFF_NO) ;
 sub_time := sub_time / (24*60) ;
 add_time := add_time / (24*60) ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 sub_time := 0 ;
 add_time := 0 ;
 END;
 act_start := act_start - sub_time;
 act_end := act_end + add_time;
 end if;
 end if ;
 last_hours := hours ;
 hours := hours + (act_end - act_start)*24 *60 ;
 
 last_drive_id := c1rec.drive_id ;
 last_date := c1rec.drive_date ;
 last_start := act_start ;
 counter := counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
END;

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
